g.text: days since the issue was opened (symlog scale) →

svg.text: Notice: a third of these issues are still open, so averaging only the closed ones makes issues look faster than they are (the table compares the medians). Kaplan–Meier counts an
open issue as 'at least this long' and drops it from the risk set at its last look. Caveats: 100 issues from two weeks of one repository; 'closed' includes 'not planned' and duplicates
(competing reasons); censoring is assumed unrelated to how long an issue would stay open.
